directions.title: Ultra-modern — Signal Lab
directions.brief: Direction: ULTRA-MODERN / SIGNAL LAB. Radical contemporary digital learning, precise and energetic, a near-black charcoal ground with acid chartreuse and ice blue, huge confident geometric sans-serif lettering, sharply cropped typographic scale, optical clarity, fine technical hairlines and abundant controlled empty space. Candidate type: Space Grotesk for display, Inter for body. Palette swatches exactly #101318, #F4F7F4, #D6FF3F, #A8D8FF, #6F7D88. Graphic language: beautifully rendered transparent optical prism with a small controlled luminous beam, alongside crisp abstract ray paths and minimal geometric marks; restrained volumetric depth in the prism only. Small control specimens are squared or subtly rounded, clear, high contrast. The whole board should feel like a forward-looking digital science publication, not gaming, cyberpunk or an enterprise dashboard. Make the title "Ultra-modern" visible.

directions.title: Classic — Natural Philosophy
directions.brief: Direction: CLASSIC SCHOLARLY / NATURAL PHILOSOPHY. A beautifully typeset traditional scientific atlas and fine academic press identity, warm ivory paper ground, deep navy ink, restrained oxblood and antique brass accents. Confident old-style serif display, elegant readable serif body, small caps, carefully spaced hairline rules, well-proportioned folio details and classic book typography. Candidate type: Libre Baskerville for display, Source Serif 4 for reading. Palette swatches exactly #F4ECDD, #172C42, #752E3D, #B29458, #756E62. Graphic language: exquisite copperplate-style line engraving of an optical lens and ray experiment, small labeled scientific figures, fine crosshatching and restrained editorial ornaments, not fantasy decoration. Include an exceptionally composed title and typographic specimens that feel like a new edition of an enduring textbook. Small interface samples translate the printed atlas language into usable high-contrast controls. This is authoritative and warm, never aged or distressed beyond legibility. Make the title "Classic" visible.

directions.title: Modern classic — Editorial Light
directions.brief: Direction: MODERN CLASSIC / EDITORIAL LIGHT. Contemporary literary magazine meets a thoughtfully designed learning journal. Warm off-white ground, forest-green ink, terracotta emphasis and soft sage, spare art direction and refined asymmetry. Graceful contemporary serif display paired with clean humanist sans-serif body and UI; unusually beautiful typography, well-paced whitespace, quiet thin dividers, subtly rounded functional controls. Candidate type: Newsreader for display, Manrope for body and UI. Palette swatches exactly #F8F6F0, #263D35, #B75B42, #CBD4C3, #E4DBCA. Graphic language: flat editorial cut-paper geometry and delicate analytical linework showing an optical lens, light paths and overlapping translucent planes, elegant and tactile but not handmade doodles. Use one generous graphic arrangement, small supporting motifs and a crisp type specimen. This direction should feel calm, cultured, approachable and current, visibly distinct from a traditional academic atlas and from aggressive digital modernism. Make the title "Modern classic" visible.

directions.title: Gothic — Illuminated Knowledge
directions.brief: Direction: GOTHIC / ILLUMINATED KNOWLEDGE. An exquisitely crafted Gothic knowledge manuscript translated into a viable contemporary learning identity. Charcoal-ink ground, pale vellum text panels, wine-dark burgundy, antique gold and oxidized sage. Authentic expressive blackletter reserved for the large direction title and a short display specimen; clear Source Sans 3 for every paragraph, label and control so a future learning website stays accessible. Candidate type: UnifrakturCook for display accents, Source Sans 3 for reading and UI. Palette swatches exactly #191B22, #EEE4CF, #6A263D, #A88F57, #607C73. Graphic language: pointed-arch framing, spare illuminated manuscript borders, architectural tracery and a precise diagram of light travelling through colored glass, rich ink-and-gold details balanced by large calm readable areas. Sophisticated secular study and scholarly mystery; no skulls, occult sigils, religious iconography, militaristic emblems, horror tropes or illegible dense medieval text. Small UI specimens have clean geometry and extremely legible labels. The Gothic character must be unmistakable in lettering, composition and framing without overwhelming learning content. Make the title "Gothic" visible.

directions.title: Bauhaus-inspired — Learning Workshop
directions.brief: Direction: BAUHAUS-INSPIRED / LEARNING WORKSHOP. Bold modernist educational workshop, sunny, experimental and visually literate, suitable for serious learners rather than a preschool app. Warm chalk-white ground, near-black type, saturated vermilion, cobalt and ochre. Strong geometric sans-serif display, highly readable humanist sans-serif body, active asymmetric composition, large constructive shapes and deliberate typographic rhythm. Candidate type: Outfit for display, Atkinson Hyperlegible for reading. Palette swatches exactly #F2EDDF, #202B31, #DF4C38, #2357B7, #E6B940. Graphic language: circles, semicircles, arcs and precise cut-paper-like planes assemble into a memorable optical experiment, modular rays and lenses, flat confident color blocking with fine diagram annotations. Make the graphic system feel systematic and inventive, not random confetti or generic SaaS illustration. Small video, chapter and answer-selection specimens inherit the same geometric grammar. Friendly and tactile, with real compositional courage and ample clean reading space; sharply distinct from the other four styles. Make the title "Bauhaus workshop" visible.
